meta.searchTool: Claude Code WebSearch (mode "standard"), one research agent per vertical
meta.rules: 4 primary + 2 alternate picks per segment; independent local companies on their own domain; lead-gen directories (Angi, Yelp, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, Networx, ...) and national franchises rejected; every homepage checked with WebFetch; unique domains across all 54 picks. Only primaries are captured.
meta.rankMethod: rank = 1-based position of the pick in the WebSearch result list for the exact query string. The unfiltered lists were almost entirely directories, job boards and franchise pages, so each query was re-run with the vertical's blockedDomains filter below; rejected results that still came through count toward the rank.
